name: Annihilation gets the Knight of Xoroth spellbook tab, not General (#7465)
contract: Annihilation 504581 is a temporary replacement AscensionXoroth.cpp swaps in for 800340 (skill line 64,
SkillLineAbility row 86489) while auras 706502 and 712294 are both active. 504581 had no SkillLineAbility
row of its own, so the client placed it under General instead of the Knight of Xoroth tab - the same
defect and fix shape as Primal Weapons (#8295, rev_20261020_83_coa_primal_weapons_skill_line.sql). The
fix repurposes SkillLineAbility.dbc row 777 (a duplicate of row 12820: both map spell 965426 'Meditate'
with the same SkillLine/RaceMask/ClassMask and differ only in MinSkillLineRank, which AcquireMethod 0
ignores, so row 12820 keeps covering 965426) for 504581 at skill line 64, the same line
800340 already carries. This proves the server's own loaded SkillLineAbility data now places 504581 on
line 64 before and after the swap, independent of the client-rendered tab itself, which this harness

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
CONTROL: the base ability's own skill line is 64, Knight of Xoroth
THE FIX: Annihilation now carries the same skill line as the ability it replaces
FIXTURE: own the base ability the swap replaces
SETUP: the swap actually replaced the base ability
Annihilation still carries skill line 64 once the swap is in effect
